arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse
from datetime import datetime

# Test that +0100 and +01:00 produce equivalent FixedTzOffset instances
tz_from_0100 = parse.parse('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+0100 b').fixed[0].tzinfo
tz_from_01colon = parse.parse('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+01:00 b').fixed[0].tzinfo

print('From +0100:', tz_from_0100)
print('  name:', tz_from_0100._name, 'offset:', tz_from_0100._offset)
print()
print('From +01:00:', tz_from_01colon)
print('  name:', tz_from_01colon._name, 'offset:', tz_from_01colon._offset)
print()
print('Are they equal?', tz_from_0100 == tz_from_01colon)
print()

# Also test negative offset
tz_minus5 = parse.parse('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20-0500 b').fixed[0].tzinfo
print('From -0500:', tz_minus5)
print('  name:', tz_minus5._name, 'offset:', tz_minus5._offset)
"
